version_history.content: Original invoice. Total Due: $8,500.00. Due date: 13 April 2025.

version_history.change: FreeText annotation (object 17) added over the Total line — overlays '$48,500.00' over '$8,500.00'
Second FreeText annotation (object 20) added over the due date — overlays 'Due: 18 July 2025' over 'Due: 13 April 2025'

detection_commands.get_eof_offsets: python3 -c "d=open('lab03_incremental.pdf','rb').read(); [print(f'Version {i+1} EOF at byte {d.find(b\"%%EOF\",pos)}') for i,(pos) in enumerate([0]+[d.find(b\"%%EOF\",p)+5 for p in [d.find(b\"%%EOF\")]])]"
detection_commands.peepdf_versions: pdf> info  (shows modification dates per version)

exercises.q: How many %%EOF markers does the file contain?
exercises.a: 3 (indicating 2 incremental updates: original creation plus two saves)

exercises.q: What was the original Total Due in Version 1?
exercises.a: $8,500.00 (visible in the extracted Version 1, before any incremental update)

exercises.q: What Producer wrote the incremental updates?
exercises.a: PDF-XChange Editor 10.0 (Version 1 was authored in LibreOffice 7.3)

exercises.q: What content does the Version 2 FreeText annotation cover?
exercises.a: The invoice total — a FreeText annotation overlays '$48,500.00' over the original '$8,500.00'

exercises.q: What does the Version 3 incremental update change?
exercises.a: It adds a second FreeText annotation altering the due date from 13 April 2025 to 18 July 2025

exercises.q: Extract Version 1 to a separate file and verify its MD5.
exercises.a: Using d.find(b'%%EOF')+5 the extracted Version 1 is 2703 bytes, MD5 038d8cd64cd74b4ced27f475fba5e108
